t: Protect yourself from the invisible threat of carbon monoxide in your home with this discreet, ultra slim CO alarm. Powered by a 10-Year sealed lithium battery to provide long-lasting reliable carbon monoxide detection. A clear digital display prominently shows the word 'Alarm' when CO is detected, while the quiet test function allows for discreet testing at a lower volume. Features advanced electrochemical sensor, IP44 splash protection, and night-time sensing for reduced LED intensity. The memory function indicates previous alarm activation, while Sleep Easy silences low battery chirps for 9 hours. A tamperproof seal ensures continuous protection without the need for battery replacements. The ultra slim design makes it ideal for homes, caravans, motorhomes, and boats.
b: Night Time Sensing Provides Reduced Heartbeat Intensity
